tools.name: start_quickscan
tools.description: Starts a scan of a public homepage for cookies and tracking observed before consent interaction, or reuses recent evidence. Returns a scan ID and, for reused scans, the evidence timestamp when known and the domain cooldown end. The scan scope excludes private pages, legal verdicts, accept/reject tes

tools.name: get_quickscan_result
tools.description: Retrieves scan progress or sanitized findings for a CookieRisk scan ID. Findings can include the visible banner provider and controls, CookieRisk score, pre-consent tracking status, tag or service classifications, browser-recorded initiator hosts, and consent signals. Page settings and scan-wide net
